units.source_text: 侍女之中，有一个葵姬所特别爱怜的女童，名叫贵君，父母双亡，身世孤苦。

en.t: Among the serving women was a little girl whom Lady Aoi especially cherished; her name was Kimi, and having lost both parents, she lived a lonely and pitiable life.

units.source_text: 源氏公子认为此人的确可怜可爱，对她说：“贵君，今后由我来做你的保护人。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought the child truly pitiful and dear, and said to her, "Kimi, from now on I will be your protector."
Kimi then began to sob softly.

units.source_text: 她身穿一件短短的衫子，染得比别人更黑。

en.t: She wore a short little robe, dyed darker than anyone else's.

units.source_text: 外面罩着黑色上衣和萱草色裙子，姿态十分娇美。

en.t: Over it she had a black outer jacket and a daylily-colored skirt, and her appearance was exceedingly delicate and lovely.

units.source_text: 公子又对众侍女说：“但愿不忘旧情的人，忍耐目前的寂寥，切勿抛舍这个婴儿，大家照旧在此服务。

en.t: The prince also said to the serving women, "I hope those who have not forgotten their old affection will endure the present loneliness, not abandon this little child, and continue to serve here as before.

units.source_text: 已经凤去台空，若再故人星散，岂不更增冷落？”

en.t: The phoenix has already flown away and the terrace stands empty; if the old companions scatter like stars as well, would that not make the desolation still greater?"

units.source_text: 他劝大家耐心忍性，长久共处。

en.t: He urged them all to be patient, restrain their sorrow, and remain together for a long time.

units.source_text: 但众侍女都想：“哪有这事！

en.t: But all the serving women thought, "How could that possibly happen!

units.source_text: 自今以后，恐怕更加盼不到你的光临了吧！”

en.t: From now on, even if we long for your visits, we will probably have even less hope of seeing you!"
They were all overcome by a feeling of loneliness.
